lines: Riley Chen
+1 (555) 010-9054 | riley.chen@example.com | example.com/in/rchen
EDUCATION
Harbor State University | B.B.A. in Finance | Metro City, USA | Sep 2016 - May 2020
EXPERIENCE
Lakeside Golf Club | Caddie | Metro City, USA | Aug 2025 - Present
- Caddied about 5 rounds a week, carrying bags and reading greens for members.
- Helped the pro shop run the weekend junior tournament.
Stonebridge Manufacturing | Financial Analyst | Metro City, USA | Jan 2023 - Jun 2025
- Improved close efficiency by 40% by automating reconciliations and intercompany eliminations.
- Modeled the capital plan for 12 plant projects in a shared NPV template, so every request used the same discount rate and payback rules.
- Wrote the variance commentary for the monthly board pack, explaining each line more than 5% off budget.
- Valued the acquisition target by discounting its free cash flow to equity at the company's weighted average cost of capital.
- Reported a 45% group EBITDA margin by adding the EBITDA margins of the three business units.
- Built the rolling 18-month cash-flow forecast for a USD 600M manufacturer, keeping monthly forecast error under 4% and letting treasury pay down USD 40M of revolver debt early.
Crescent Bank | Credit Analyst | Metro City, USA | Jul 2020 - Dec 2022
- Underwrote 60 small-business loans worth USD 45M, and none of the approved loans defaulted in their first two years.
- Reviewed 3 years of declined applications; my findings changed two ratio thresholds and raised approvals from 41% to 48% with no rise in early defaults.
- Writes the covenant-monitoring checklist for the portfolio, cutting missed covenant tests from 7 to 1 a year.
- Built a spreading template for borrower financials that cut each credit memo from 6 hours to 3.
PROJECTS
Regional Utility Valuation | Independent Project | Excel | Nov 2024 - Present
- Valued a listed regional utility with a 10-year DCF and a comparable-company check, landing within 6% of the market price.
- Tested the valuation's sensitivity: a 1-point change in the discount rate moved the share value from USD 52 to USD 44.
- Shared the model and a two-page note with the university investment club, which used it in its spring pitch.
Student Investment Fund | Analyst, Team of 6 | Excel | Sep 2018 - May 2019
- Supported the FP&A team with financial reporting and analysis.
- Rebuilt the fund's performance report to show returns against its benchmark, which the committee used at every meeting.
- Built an 18-month cash forecast for a USD 600M business, holding error to about 4% and freeing USD 40M to repay debt early.
SKILLS
Tools: Excel, Bloomberg Terminal
Methods: financial modeling, DCF valuation, forecasting, credit analysis

items.says: Check that the LinkedIn URL works and leads to a current profile.
Add a location if it is relevant to the jobs you are targeting.
Put experience ahead of education if space is tight.
items.because: At this career stage, experience should lead.

items.says: Change “Caddied” to present tense if you still do this work.
Consider whether the number of rounds adds value.
items.because: You are targeting finance jobs.

items.says: Specify the scope of your tournament help if it was substantial.
items.because: A reader cannot tell what you were responsible for.

items.says: Define what improved by 40% and make sure the measure is supportable.
items.because: “Efficiency” alone is vague.

items.says: Clarify your analytical contribution beyond using a common template.
Distinguish NPV assumptions from payback rules.
items.because: They are different decision measures.

items.says: Define the 5% threshold and whether it applied to every line item.
items.because: Readers need to know whether it was a materiality threshold.

items.says: Clarify whether you explained causes, not just variances.
Free cash flow to equity should not be discounted at WACC.
items.because: WACC is used with free cash flow to the firm.

items.says: Adding business-unit EBITDA margins does not produce a group margin.
items.because: Group margin must use group EBITDA and revenue or an appropriately revenue-weighted calculation.

items.says: Specify a consistent measure for “forecast error under 4%. ”
Verify that the forecast genuinely enabled the early debt repayment.
items.because: The two may have merely coincided.

items.says: Clarify the observation period for the two-year no-default claim.
items.because: Loans approved near the end of your tenure may not have a substantiated full two-year period.

items.says: Explain how findings from declined applications supported changing the thresholds.
Check that the approval-rate and early-default comparisons use comparable periods and cohorts.
Change “Writes” to past tense if the checklist was completed in your former role.
Clarify whether the drop from seven missed tests to one was measured across comparable years.
Specify whether the time saving covered the entire credit memo or only financial spreading.
items.because: The line may overattribute the time saved.

items.says: Reassess “Present” if the project is complete.
items.because: An open-ended date makes its status unclear.

items.says: Do not imply that being within 6% of market price validates the valuation.
items.because: Price is a comparison point, not proof of accuracy.

items.says: Explain what the comparable-company check contributed.
State the direction of the discount-rate change and its starting point.
items.because: The USD 52-to-USD 44 range is otherwise hard to interpret.

items.says: Check that “spring pitch” aligns with the project dates.
Describe the club’s use without implying the pitch was yours if it was not.
Make your role and the fund context clearer.
items.because: “Team of 6” is less useful than relevant responsibility if space is limited.

items.says: Remove the FP&A line unless it genuinely describes Student Investment Fund work.
items.because: It sounds like corporate experience.

items.says: Make your contribution more specific.
items.because: The line is too general to establish it.

items.says: Specify the benchmark or reporting improvement if it matters to your target roles.
The USD 600M cash-forecast claim closely duplicates the Stonebridge bullet.
The cash forecast is implausibly attributed to a 2018–19 student-fund role.
items.because: If it was separate work, its figures, organization and dates need verification.

items.says: List only tools you can discuss confidently and consider adding specific tools used in the work above.
items.because: The current list is broad compared with the experience bullets.

items.says: List only methods you can discuss confidently.
items.because: The current list is broad compared with the experience bullets.

items.says: Lead with relevant finance experience and give the caddie job less space than the analyst roles if necessary.
items.because: The résumé may need to fit one page.
